content.short: Blum is a hybrid crypto exchange on Telegram offering CEX and DEX features with a built-in farming game.
content.description: Blum is an innovative hybrid cryptocurrency exchange designed to operate entirely within the Telegram messenger. It combines the ease of use of a centralized exchange (CEX) with the non-custodial security of a decentralized exchange (DEX), allowing users to trade assets from multiple chains seamlessly. Blum features an integrated 'tap-to-earn' mini-game where users farm Blum Points, facilitating early user engagement and distribution. By bridging the gap between social platforms and professional trading, Blum aims to simplify crypto access for everyone.
content.meta: Trade any token on Telegram with Blum, the hybrid DEX/CEX. Farm rewards and trade on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
